neighbours.label: the word that turns a phrase into a top-rank or honor title (the 'of' in 'Player of the Year', 'No.' in 'the No. 1', 'Record' in 'Architect of Record', 'down' in 'hands down'), as against the same people and things described without a ranking
fire: Last spring she was named Teacher of the Year by the district.
The magazine picked the salmon tart as its Dish of the Year.
Analysts expect the rookie to become the No. 1 receiver.
Experts call it the No. 3 threat to coastal towns.
That was, hands down, the best concert I have ever seen.
He was voted Coach of the Year after the title run.
The firm served as Engineer of Record for the new bridge.
Sales software is now the No. 2 priority for small firms.
quiet: Last spring she was hired as a teacher by the district.
The magazine printed a recipe for the salmon tart.
Analysts expect the rookie to play as a receiver.
Experts call it a growing threat to coastal towns.
That was a loud concert, and I have seen many.
He was hired as coach after the title run.
The firm did the engineering work for the new bridge.
Sales software is now a priority for small firms.

predictions: fire 0.5-0.7 on of/No./down inside ranking titles; plain descriptions below 0.05
notes: Card: ' of' x10 (Builder of the Year, Plant of the Year), ' No' x4 (the No. 2 quarterback), ' Record', ' down' (hands down), 'puted' (undisputed). Probe: 'Builder of the Year' 0.543, 'Plant of the Year' 0.513, 'the No. 2 quarterback' 0.695, 'Architect of Record' 0.619, 'hands down' 0.704; plain versions 0.014-0.030.
